briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent AGI capabilities race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward agentic systems amid surging investment and compute buildout. Regulatory pressure mounts while vulnerabilities persist across deployed models.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and DeepSeek R2 push context windows beyond 2M tokens. Meta and xAI deploy open-weight rivals targeting enterprise workloads.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates AI RMF 2.0 while new exploits target agent swarms.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce $40B+ data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports AI chip yields exceeding 85%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination breakthroughs trigger uncontrolled capability jumps before 2027 safety standards mature?
